description: This file contains the implementation of a gauge for metrics collection using the Kamon library. It provides methods to manipulate gauge values, manage tags, and retrieve gauge information, encapsulated within the KamonGauge class.

classes.name: KamonGauge
classes.description: An implementation of the Gauge interface that uses Kamon for metrics instrumentation. It allows creating gauges, updating their values, tagging, and resetting.

methods.name: newGauge
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Gauge instance with the specified name.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the gauge's value by one.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements the gauge's value by one.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to a specific Long value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the gauge.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with an added tag key-value pair.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new Gauge instance with multiple tags applied.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific tag key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the gauge.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the gauge value to zero.

methods.name: getKamonInternalGauge
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves the Kamon gauge object with the current tags.
